set: GK Drill 3: Important days and themes

sections.name: GK drill: Important days and themes

questions.q: International Tiger Day is observed on:
questions.why: Asked in the September 2026 GPSC papers.

questions.q: Indian Akshay Urja (Renewable Energy) Day is observed on:
questions.why: Rajiv Gandhi's birth anniversary; also Sadbhavana Diwas.

questions.q: World Health Day is observed on:
questions.why: WHO's founding day (1948).

questions.q: The theme of World Health Day 2026 was:
opts: Together for Health. Stand with Science.
questions.why: 'Healthy Beginnings, Hopeful Futures' was the 2025 theme.

questions.q: The theme of the International Day of Yoga 2026 was:
opts: Yoga for One Earth, One Health
questions.why: 21 June. 2025's theme was 'Yoga for One Earth, One Health'.

questions.q: National Doctors' Day in India is observed on 1 July, the birth anniversary of:
questions.why: 1 July is also GST Day and Chartered Accountants' Day.

questions.q: National Science Day (28 February) commemorates:
opts: the discovery of the Raman effect
questions.why: C. V. Raman announced it on 28 February 1928.

questions.q: World Hepatitis Day is observed on:
questions.why: 24 March is World TB Day.

questions.q: World No-Tobacco Day is observed on:
questions.why: 26 June is the day against drug abuse.

questions.q: World Environment Day is observed on:
questions.why: 22 April is Earth Day; 5 December is World Soil Day.

questions.q: The International Day for Biological Diversity is observed on:
questions.why: 3 March is World Wildlife Day.

questions.q: World Ozone Day is observed on:
questions.why: Marks the Montreal Protocol (1987).

questions.q: Ayurveda Day is observed every year from 2025 on a fixed date:
questions.why: Earlier it fell on Dhanteras, which moves each year.

questions.q: World Mental Health Day is observed on:
questions.why: 10 September is World Suicide Prevention Day.

questions.q: World Diabetes Day is observed on:
questions.why: Frederick Banting's birthday; also Children's Day in India.

questions.q: World Heart Day is observed on:
questions.why: World Heart Federation.

questions.q: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Divas) is observed on:
questions.why: The Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution on 26 November 1949.

questions.q: National Panchayati Raj Day is observed on:
questions.why: The 73rd Amendment came into force on 24 April 1993.

questions.q: World Wetlands Day is observed on:
questions.why: The Ramsar Convention was signed on 2 February 1971.

questions.q: The theme of World Water Day 2026 was:
questions.why: 22 March.

questions.q: Kargil Vijay Diwas is observed on:
questions.why: 16 December is Vijay Diwas (1971 war).

questions.q: Army Day, Air Force Day and Navy Day fall on:
questions.why: Order: Army, Air Force, Navy.

questions.q: National Statistics Day (29 June) marks the birth anniversary of:
questions.why: Engineers' Day (15 September) honours Visvesvaraya.

questions.q: World Population Day is observed on:
questions.why: 11 May is National Technology Day; 15 July is World Youth Skills Day.

questions.q: World AIDS Day is observed on:
questions.why: 4 February is World Cancer Day.
